performance.verdict: Heating campaigns overdue; lead drought is structural, not just spend-driven.

findings.text: CPL rose 19.91% week-over-week to an implied ~$54 while leads fell 38.89%; all 34 tracked leads attributed to Meta despite Google taking $969.86 of 28d spend.
9 overdue SOW milestones including heating campaigns (due 2026-10-01), LSA re-enable (2026-09-01), and fall creative package (2026-09-30) — none confirmed complete.
Intake owner unconfirmed since Vivian left 7/7 — GHL shows 770 opportunities created vs only 86 won and 0 appointments; speed-to-lead automation may be routing to an empty seat.

3-day lead signal (Oct 27–29): 0+2+1=3 leads vs prior 3 days (Oct 24–26): 3+1+0=4 — flat at near-zero volume; Google spend averaged only $28.54/day over last 3 days, well below the ~$57/day seen Oct 4–7.
GBP actions surged 33.33% WoW (144 total, 21 calls) while paid leads collapsed — organic intent exists but paid capture is failing to convert it at current throttled spend of $40.14/day.

suggestions.text: Confirm intake owner has active GHL login and after-hours coverage before any budget increase; blocks scale-up gate.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian (dispatch) left 7/7 and the intake seat is unconfirmed. suggestions.text: Escalate 9 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer; heating campaigns and LSA re-enable are 29–59 days late entering peak heating season.
